sentences.text: Schizooura was a feathery creature that lived 125.5 million years ago in western Liaoning, China.
It possessed a toothless beak, a feature that distinguishes it from other modern birds.
Only one fossil of this species has ever been discovered, making it relatively unknown to science.
The single known specimen is an articulated nearly complete skeleton with feather impressions.
This animal was a ground forager that collected food from the floor.
Schizooura is classified as a basal ornithuromorph dinosaur, making it a relative of modern birds.
Initial phylogenetic analysis places Schizooura as more primitive than Hongshanornis.
Remains were discovered in the Jiufotang Formation deposits, where the animal lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
